title: POV: You're Getting The City Ready For Arbor Day
description:
Our City staff is preparing for Arbor Day, and now we need you! April is National Volunteer Month, and you can join us at Gompers Neighborhood Park in Encanto on April 24, 2026!🌳✨

If you love trees and our parks, come help us plant new ones and beautify our community together. Let’s grow a green San Diego! For information and to register, visit sandiego.gov/event/arbor-day 💚🌱
